commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Mama Balde (Brest) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Philipp Kohn intercepts the ball.
90+4' 2 - 1 GOAL after a blunder! Keeper Philipp Kohn makes a complete hash of a weak mid range shot from Mahdi Camara (Brest) and let’s the ball squirm into the net. It’s now 2:1.
90+3' Mama Balde (Brest) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
90+3' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Folarin Balogun (Monaco) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
86' A substitution has been made. Breel Embolo goes off and Folarin Balogun (Monaco) comes on.
86' Breel Embolo (Monaco) attempts to find Mika Biereth with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
84' Mathias Pereira Lage goes off the pitch and Romain Del Castillo (Brest) comes on.
81' Adi Hutter has decided to substitute Maghnes Akliouche and he is replaced by Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco).
80' What a great touch by Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
78' Eric Roy prepares a substitution. Abdallah Sima is replaced by Mama Balde (Brest).
77' A substitution has been made. Hugo Magnetti is replaced by Kamory Doumbia (Brest).
77' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
76' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
76' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going into the roof of the net, but Marco Bizot has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
75' Caio Henrique (Monaco) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Al Musrati (Monaco) replaces Lamine Camara.
71' The ball is out of play. Monaco win a corner kick.
71' Total attempts – 8:6. The shots on goal statistics – 2:1.
71' Monaco take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
70' Monaco have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The linesman makes the right call and Monaco will have a corner.
65' The free kick is taken by Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest), but ball is cleared.
64' Kenny Lala (Brest) is punished with the yellow card.
64' Lamine Camara (Monaco) is cautioned by the referee.
63' 1 - 1 Goal! Denis Zakaria (Monaco) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Marco Bizot.
62' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
61' The Monaco players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

61' Play continues despite the shouts by some Monaco players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Thomas Leonard interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
60' Surely that's handball by one of the Brest players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

59' The resulting corner from Lamine Camara (Monaco) is cleared by the defence. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Monaco will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
59' Breel Embolo (Monaco) fires the ball towards the left side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
58' The corner from Lamine Camara (Monaco) is intercepted by Marco Bizot.
55' Breel Embolo (Monaco) gets to the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
55' Lamine Camara (Monaco) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
51' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.

51' Christian Mawissa Elebi (Monaco) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a free kick to Brest, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
50' Lamine Camara (Monaco) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Takumi Minamino comes off for Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco).
46' Adi Hutter has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Vanderson (Monaco) comes on the pitch for Thilo Kehrer.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' The referee is firm and issues Mahdi Camara (Brest) a deserved yellow card.
42' 1 - 0 Abdallah Sima (Brest) has a great chance inside the box and puts the ball into the back of the net.

42' What an opportunity! Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) wastes a huge chance as he latches on to a perfect pass and produces a first-time blast from point blank range. It goes towards the roof of the net, but Philipp Kohn reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
39' Abdallah Sima (Brest) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
34' Mahdi Camara (Brest) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
31' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Marco Bizot comes off his line to intercept.
30' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) was quite harsh and Thomas Leonard didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
30' Massadio Haidara (Brest) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Philipp Kohn intercepts the ball.
29' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) sends a cross into the box, but Marco Bizot comes off his line to gather the ball.

27' Abdallah Sima (Brest) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Hugo Magnetti (Brest) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
25' 4:1 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The current number of shots on goal is 1:0.
22' Abdallah Sima (Brest) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Philipp Kohn, who smothers the ball.
21' The ball finds it way to Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) inside the box and his first-time shot flies a whisker past the right post.

20' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) serves up a nice cross, but Philipp Kohn punches the ball away. Philipp Kohn makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Mahdi Camara (Brest) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the roof of the net.
18' Mahdi Camara (Brest) collects the ball from the free kick and immediately sends his close-range effort just over the crossbar!
17' Breel Embolo (Monaco) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
16' Breel Embolo (Monaco) is penalised for a foul. Thomas Leonard had a clear view and blows his whistle.
12' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

12' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence. Brest have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
11' Lamine Camara (Monaco) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.

10' Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Brest) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. It's a free kick to Monaco, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
9' Monaco control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
6' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Mika Biereth (Monaco) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
3' Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul after Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) hacks down one of his opponents.
3' Kenny Lala (Brest) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
1' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Brest will have the kick-off.
Thomas Leonard is introduced as the referee for today's match.
